projects.title: Autonomous Discord Conversational System
projects.description: Built an adaptive AI for Discord that uses long-term memory, summarization, proactive messaging, and relationship-state modeling to support more natural, human-like conversation over time. Designed the system around cognitive science ideas like memory, social cognition, and personality perception, while implementing the underlying LLM prompting, routing, and context-management pipeline.

projects.title: Wumpus World
projects.description: Created logical agent to solve the Wumpus World problem, in an Arduino robot and in a Minecraft simulation.

projects.title: WAVER Cafe (WolfJam 2024 3rd Place Winner)
projects.description: WAVER Cafe is a restaurant management visual novel where you play as a foxy (quite literally) barista. Serve coffee to a diverse cast of NPCs through engaging mini-games, uncovering their fascinating lives in end-of-day encounters. Brace yourself for dark twists and unexpected reveals along the way.I created the dialogue for Mittens, the cat. I was responsible for handling character interactions and story progression. I designed and implemented the freehand latte art minigame, added a realistic coffee pouring animation, and changed our foam minigame to be percentage based. Finally, I added a scoring system and implemented a game end screen with different variations based on the player's performance.This was a contest entry in the Wolfjaw Studios 2024 Wolfjam. We placed third out of 57 entries.
